content.short: $VIPER is a memecoin slithering its way through Cardano originating as a trait from the Magic Kongs collection.
content.description:
$VIPER is the second snake, often overlooked, slithering its way through Cardano. Offering the fairest launch since SNEK, $VIPER offered no presale or allocation to influencers, instead offering a vesting schedule for airdrops for $VIPER Pass holders each month until March and launching live on Cardano DEXs immediately.

$VIPER is the token powering the Viper ecosystem, offering a wide range of products and cultural significance that can't be replaced anywhere else. Most notably, $VIPER created ViperSwap, the all-in-one trading platform on Cardano offering swaps both on Cardano and cross-chain.
